title: PG-CE: A Progressive Generation Dataset with Constraint Enhancement for Controllable Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability of generating text classified as an 'Identity Attack' (discriminatory language or hate speech targeting specific identity groups) by prompting the model with the RealToxicityPrompts dataset and evaluating outputs using a DeBERTa-v3-large model fine-tuned to approximate Perspective API's toxicity scoring.
